title: Bias, Accuracy, and Trust: Gender-Diverse Perspectives on Large Language Models
findings: This paper did not investigate religion and therefore has no findings on the topic. It only mentions that anti-Muslim bias has been documented in LLMs, citing a separate study to illustrate the prevalence of social biases.
